package.description: A feature-rich AxCrypt-compatible file encryption command line toolbox.

en-US.author: Svante Seleborg
en-US.description: A feature-rich AxCrypt-compatible file encryption command line toolbox.
en-US.longDescription: Xecrets Cli is a powerful open source cryptographic command line toolbox using AxCrypt 1.x compatible file encryption. Encrypt, decrypt, list and pack files from scripts and the command line, on Windows, Linux and macOS.
en-US.name: Xecrets Cli
